project_type: Django 5.2 + DRF backend, React 19 + Vite frontend, PostgreSQL database
build_system: Backend: plain manage.py (no Makefile). Frontend: Vite via npm. Venv at c:\Users\kindi\OneDrive\Documents\TicketIQ\venv\Scripts\python.exe. Run backend commands as: .\venv\Scripts\python backend\manage.py <cmd> from TicketIQ root, or python manage.py <cmd> from backend\.
test_framework: Django built-in test runner (unittest). Command: python backend/manage.py test cinema_core (from TicketIQ root) or python manage.py test cinema_core (from backend/).
verification_instructions: 1. Activate venv: .\venv\Scripts\activate. 2. Run: python backend/manage.py check. 3. Run: python backend/manage.py test cinema_core. 4. cd frontend && npm run build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/cinema_core/migrations/0003_*.py — generated by makemigrations, must be committed.
environment_constraints: psycopg3 (not psycopg2) is used as the DB driver (package: psycopg==3.3.9, psycopg_binary==3.3.9). Pillow 13.0.0 is already installed. razorpay, reportlab, qrcode are NOT yet installed — must be installed before FEAT-002 views can be imported. .env file at TicketIQ root (loaded by settings.py via python-dotenv from BASE_DIR.parent/.env). RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET env vars drive real vs mock payment mode.
contribution_requirements: Never reset the DB or delete existing records. Never create duplicate models or routes. Existing endpoints must continue to work after every FEAT. Run manage.py check after each model change.
key_patterns: Views use permission_classes list directly on each class/viewset. AllowAny used for public endpoints (CinemaViewSet, MovieViewSet, ShowViewSet, DashboardView). IsAdminUser for write ops. Transactions via 'with transaction.atomic()' + select_for_update(). Serializers append at bottom of serializers.py. New views in views_booking.py (new file), new URL patterns appended to urlpatterns list in cinema_core/urls.py. Frontend pages: import CSS as './Page.css', use axios with API constant 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/', pattern: useEffect fetch on mount, useState for data/loading/error. Apple-inspired CSS: white bg, #f5f5f7 secondary, #007AFF primary blue, border-radius 10-14px, box-shadow 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06).
directory_structure: TicketIQ/ — project root with .env. backend/ — Django project root; backend/cinema_core/ — single Django app with models/views/serializers/urls/migrations; backend/config/ — settings/urls/wsgi. frontend/ — Vite project; frontend/src/pages/ — all page components. venv/ — Python virtualenv at project root. .agents/tasks/ticketiq-booking/ — task artifacts (this directory).
